text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $65.5k with modest overnight gains, while Ethereum is outpacing it with a 2.6% move that signals selective risk appetite returning to altcoins despite extreme fear readings. The 56.5% BTC dominance and $71B daily volume suggest the market remains cautious but not panicked—traders are dipping into alts rather than wholesale exiting—though the Fear & Greed index at 25 indicates investors are still pricing in meaningful downside risk.
